I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-random message. I confirmed that the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 19 November, which replaces the date he posted in #north-team this morning. Nothing else was needed.

The correction is now on record in this channel, but his original post in #north-team still shows the wrong date. Anyone who reads only that channel won't see the fix unless Marcus corrects it there too.
